title: Add built-in request body parsing middleware (JSON & URL‑encoded)
description: Many applications need to read request payloads. This middleware parses JSON and URL‑encoded bodies, populates `req.body`, and returns a 400 error for malformed JSON, eliminating the need for external parsers and improving developer ergonomics.
testCases: Parse valid JSON payload and verify req.body contains expected object
Parse valid URL‑encoded payload and verify req.body contains expected key/value pairs
Send malformed JSON and expect a 400 response with appropriate error message
acceptance: The middleware correctly parses JSON and URL‑encoded bodies, attaches the parsed object to `req.body`, and gracefully handles errors by responding with a 400 status and clear error message. It integrates seamlessly with existing routing and middleware chain without breaking current tests.
reason: Providing native body parsing removes a common external dependency, aligns with the framework's zero‑dependency goal, and solves a frequent pain point for developers, boosting adoption and production readiness.
